cases.q: I have PAYE, rental properties, CIS income and crypto disposals — which Self Assessment package fits?
cases.reply: Cryptoassets can create Self Assessment reporting needs. HMRC may treat disposals under Capital Gains Tax, and frequent trading can be Income Tax instead — it depends on your activity. Keep detailed records. I won’t invent your tax figure. Official guidance: https://www.gov.uk/guidance/tax-on-cryptoassets — were your crypto disposals investment-style gains, or more like a trading business?
